summary_en: Annual dividend raised from 19 yen to 26 yen per share (+37%) for FY3/26 (ended Aug 2026). Payout ratio target 35%+. Revision reflects upgraded earnings guidance: operating profit +28.1% to 4,100M yen, net income +22.2% to 3,300M yen, driven by strong semiconductor equipment market demand.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY3/26
translation_en_brief: Marumae Co., Ltd. revised its FY3/26 (fiscal year ended August 2026) dividend forecast upward on 11 June 2026. The company increased the annual dividend per share from 19 yen to 26 yen, a 37% hike. This revision follows the company's simultaneous upgrade to full-year earnings guidance: operating profit raised 28.1% to 4,100 million yen, operating income +30.0% to 3,900 million yen, and net income attributable to parent +22.2% to 3,300 million yen. The company cites robust demand from semiconductor manufacturing equipment customers and strong market conditions as drivers of the improved outlook. The dividend policy reflects management's commitment to stable profit returns to shareholders while pursuing long-term investment, with a payout ratio target of 35% or higher under the current medium-term business plan. The dividend is subject to approval at the company's scheduled shareholders' meeting in late November 2026. Note: the company executed a 2-for-1 stock split on 1 April 2026; the disclosed dividend per share reflects the post-split basis.
